requirements.reason: Showcase is shown and verified displayed before asking the user.
Contract 'never' forbids modifying the showcase; the step meaning says view only.

requirements.quote:
ask user to choose the theme to apply to artifact
    require confirmation
requirements.reason: The sequence is show, ask, confirm, read, apply, with no skipping.

requirements.quote:
ask user to choose the theme to apply to artifact
    require confirmation
      otherwise:
        return artifact as styled_artifact
requirements.reason: Applying happens only after confirmation. Otherwise the artifact is returned unchanged.

requirements.quote: read theme file from themes as theme
requirements.reason: The theme file is read before apply, and the apply step uses the loaded theme.

requirements.quote: apply the specified colors and fonts consistently throughout the artifact
requirements.reason: This is in the contract's always list and in the apply step.

requirements.quote: verify #contrast styled has proper contrast and readability from contrast
requirements.reason: Contrast is checked, fixed and retried.

requirements.quote: maintain the theme's visual identity across all slides
requirements.reason: This is in the contract's always list.

requirements.quote:
if none of the existing themes work for artifact:
    generate custom theme from description as custom_theme
requirements.reason: A custom theme is generated when no preset fits.

requirements.quote: using any basic description provided to choose colors and fonts
requirements.reason: The step meaning says to use the description, and the logic passes description to generation.

requirements.quote: Give it a similar-style name describing what the font/color combination represents.
requirements.reason: The naming requirement is in the step meaning for custom theme, which the generate step points to.

requirements.quote:
show custom_theme
    ask user to review and verify the custom theme
    require confirmation
requirements.reason: The custom theme is shown and reviewed before it is read and applied.
All ten themes are listed with the same names.

introduced.behavior: If the showcase display check fails, the skill aborts and returns the artifact unstyled.
introduced.quote:
verify #showcase theme_showcase was displayed for viewing from showcase
    otherwise:
      return artifact as styled_artifact

introduced.behavior: Writes the styled result to the artifact, which is an explicit file-write effect. The source only said to apply the theme.
Adds a check that a custom theme has a hex palette and font pairings, and aborts if it doesn't.
introduced.quote: verify #custom custom_theme has a hex palette and font pairings from custom_check

introduced.behavior: Adds a check that the loaded theme has a hex palette and font pairings, and aborts if it doesn't.
introduced.quote: verify #theme theme has hex palette and font pairings from themeload

introduced.behavior: Runs contrast-fix and retry loops that automatically adjust colors.
